records.title: Home Delivery
records.meta: Film · United States · English · comedy · written and directed by Thom Harp · released 27 Mar 2026 · 105 min · R
records.character: Ellye Ferguson (plus-sized model, in labor with her first child)
records.summary: During a stalled home birth, midwife Sara suggests that Ellye and her husband Jimmy have sex to help labor resume; later Ellye also uses a vibrator to restart contractions. Family tensions and a hospital transfer follow, and the baby is born.
records.mechanism: On-screen intimacy during labor, including a midwife-suggested sex scene and a later private attempt to restart contractions
records.evidence: Wikipedia plot describes the midwife suggesting sex and a later vibrator scene; Common Sense Media independently flags on-screen sex, masturbation, and orgasms during the childbirth story.
records.pregnancy_outcome: The baby is born in hospital; Ellye is told she will not be able to give birth again
records.pregnancy_note: Partner in the labor-intimacy scenes: husband Jimmy Ferguson; first child

records.title: The Couple Next Door
records.meta: TV series · United States · English · Starz · premiered 17 Jan 2025 · Season 1 Episode 5 “The Ultimatum” · starring Eleanor Tomlinson and Sam Heughan
records.character: Evie (wife of Pete; pregnant with Danny's child)
records.summary: After her husband Pete confronts her about the pregnancy and demands she cut contact and end it, Evie goes to Danny's police-station workplace; they have sex there, and she then tells him the baby is his.
records.mechanism: On-screen sex scene while Evie is already pregnant
records.evidence: Two independent recaps: Pete already knows Evie is pregnant before she goes to the station; Decider describes the workplace sex scene, and the second recap confirms she is already pregnant and has another intimate encounter at his work.
records.pregnancy_note: Partner in the scene: Danny (not her husband); the pregnancy is already known to Evie and Pete before the scene
